description: This file defines the 'Comment' controller class within the Opencart admin panel, handling CRUD operations, approval, spam marking, rating refresh, and listing of comments related to CMS articles.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments in the CMS section of Opencart admin panel, including listing, approval, spam marking, deletion, and rating updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the comments list page with header, footer, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to get the list of comments.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of comments with filtering, pagination, and action links.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Marks selected comments as approved and updates their status.

methods.name: spam
methods.description: Marks selected comments as spam, deletes associated comments, and updates user history.

methods.name: rating
methods.description: Refreshes comment ratings by aggregating individual ratings and updating comment rating scores.
